jobs.jd_full: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. The Role: Based out of our Hong Kong office, this role will be focused on generating and qualifying leads that will build Airwallex’s Hong Kong SME / Start Up sales pipeline. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) , you should be excited about engaging with prospects to find out about their needs, adept at identifying high value opportunities and capable of managing early sales funnel activities. You are used to delivering value in complex situations and are energized by learning about new and existing products. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of the demand generation and sales process, the articulation of Airwallex’s value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets. With the team, there are many opportunities to progress as the business continues to grow. If you’re hungry, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you! Responsibilities: Initiate contact with potential customers through email outreach or cold calling and follow up on designated touchpoints in a customer journey Move quality leads through the funnel while connecting them to a salesperson and arranging meetings Develop relationships with prospects to uncover needs through effective questioning to qualify interest and viability to prepare hand-off to sales Update activity and contact information within the CRM system and support reporting efforts Inform and recommend outreach strategies and best practices through testing various types of touchpoints Contribute to building out best practices in this area as we grow the team Collaborate and provide feedback and insights to Marketing to help improve targeting and messaging Work closely with your designated Account Executive on the handover & first call What you bring: Target-oriented - You are motivated by stretch targets that facilitate business growth and reward you for direct impact Customer focused - You are excited to learn about your prospect’s business and rely on data to help solve issues Process driven - You enjoy developing, documenting, and following procedures to ensure they are efficient, scalable, and defensible A team player - You are a natural at building relationships with your colleagues but can work independently at ease A master prioritizer - You leverage sound judgment to quickly assess all the tasks at hand and expertly prioritize them Obsessively Curious - You know when to dig a little deeper to get to the bottom of a problem and solve it; in doing so, you ask the right questions necessary to arrive at a sound, risk-based decision Track record of top performance or prior success in an BDR-related role Superior verbal and written communication skills Strong interest in technology and/or financial services Self-starter who is able to operate in a hyper growth environment Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. Equal opportunity Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.jd_full:
Business Development Executive (Fresh Graduate)

Our Journey
The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific's leading shopping and rewards platform, trusted by over 20 million active members across 13 markets, including Germany and the United States. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack saves members money and time with more ways to earn and more to do with what they earn, and empowers merchants and brand partners to effectively engage its members. Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales and half a million transactions a day for more than 20,000 online and in-store partners.

This is a role with our latest product, ShopBack Pay, a new initiative that helps customer earns Cashback in the offline/online world.

Your Adventure Ahead
- Drive Growth: Play a hands-on role in acquiring and onboarding small and medium business (SMB) merchant partners for ShopBack Pay.
- Learn by Doing: Gain real-world sales experience — from prospecting and pitching to closing and nurturing partnerships.
- Stay Ahead: Keep updated on industry trends, competitors, and new opportunities to help shape ShopBack Pay’s growth strategy.
- Collaborate to Win: Work closely with cross-functional teams (Operations, Account Management, and Marketing) to execute ShopBack Pay initiatives.
- Make It Better: Provide insights and feedback to streamline our sales processes and optimize merchant experiences.
- Be our Merchants' Hero: Support our merchant partners, understand their needs, and help them succeed with ShopBack Pay.

Essentials to Succeed
- Fresh graduates interested to learn and gain hands-on experience in Business Development are welcomed to apply!
- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field
- Excellent communication and presentation skills — you can tell a story and make ideas resonate.
- Strong interpersonal and analytical skills; you enjoy connecting dots and people.
- A self-starter with a “can’t-is-not-an-option” mindset — resilient, curious, and ready to learn fast.
- A problem-solver who is not discouraged by failure or mistakes.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, juggling multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy
- Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment where you’ll wear multiple hats.
- Passionate about innovation, fintech, and building something impactful from the ground up.
- AI Competency: Demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) to develop new or improve workflows, enhance productivity, and drive efficiency at scale.

jobs.jd_full:
Business Development Manager (Junior to Mid-Level) – Hong Kong

Role Overview
CertiK is the global leader in Web3 and blockchain security. We are seeking a high-energy, target-driven Business Development Manager based in Hong Kong to accelerate our growth across the APAC region.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end sales cycles—from proactive outbound lead generation to closing deals for our suite of security solutions, including smart contract audits, penetration testing, formal verification, Skynet threat monitoring, and compliance services.

You will serve as a bridge between traditional financial institutions entering the digital asset space (Web2) and crypto-native projects (Web3), leveraging your regional market understanding and language capabilities to secure high-value security partnerships.

Key Responsibilities
- Pipeline Generation & Outbound BD: Actively identify, prospect, and engage decision-makers (CTOs, Founders, Head of Web3/Digital Assets) across blockchain protocols, DeFi projects, RWA tokenization platforms, exchanges, and Web2 institutional entrants.
- Full Sales Cycle Execution: Drive complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial outreach and technical discovery to proposal creation, price negotiation, and contract execution.
- Enterprise & Institutional Sales: Engage traditional financial institutions, asset managers, family offices, and tech enterprises seeking institutional-grade security for their Web3 initiatives.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with CertiK’s global security engineering, solutions architecture, delivery, and marketing teams to ensure smooth deal execution and client onboarding.
- Account Expansion & Networking: Build long-term relationships with key accounts to drive renewals, audit add-ons, and monitoring subscriptions. Represent CertiK at local industry events, conferences, and ecosystem meetups.

Key Requirements & Qualifications
- Experience: 2–5 years of successful B2B sales or business development experience in Web3, blockchain security, cybersecurity, SaaS, or institutional fintech.
- Domain Knowledge: Strong familiarity with Web3 native ecosystems (EVM chains, Layer 1/Layer 2 protocols, DeFi, tokenomics, smart contract architectures). Good understanding of Web2 cybersecurity fundamentals (e.g., penetration testing, code review, risk assessments).
- Core Languages: Professional working proficiency (written and spoken) in English and Mandarin for regional collaboration and global client management.
- Track Record: Proven ability to meet or exceed quarterly sales quotas through structured outbound outreach and consultative deal closing.

Language & Skills Bonuses (Highly Preferred)
- Cantonese Advantage (Bonus): Native or full professional fluency in Cantonese is a strong advantage for localized Hong Kong institutional coverage, government/regulatory networks, and local Web3 builders.
- Regional Asian Languages (Bonus): Proficiency in additional regional languages—such as Japanese, Korean, or Vietnamese—is a significant bonus for driving APAC cross-border expansion or local market expansion.
- Security & Audit Familiarity: Direct experience selling smart contract audits, penetration tests, or bug bounty services.
- Regulatory Context: Understanding of Hong Kong’s digital asset licensing landscape (e.g., SFC VASP regulations, HKMA stablecoin frameworks).
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

This role must be performed outside the United States. We are unable to consider candidates who will work from within the U.S.

jobs.jd_full:
Head of Commercial, ShopBack Pay

Our Journey
The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific's leading shopping and rewards platform, trusted by over 20 million active members across 13 markets, including Germany and the United States. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack saves members money and time with more ways to earn and more to do with what they earn, and empowers merchants and brand partners to effectively engage its members. Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales and half a million transactions a day for more than 20,000 online and in-store partners.

As the Head of ShopBack Pay, you will drive high impact growth and development of our new business unit - ShopBack Pay, with direct P&L ownership. You will be responsible for leading and empowering high performing sales and marketing teams to build and scale our new business from scratch in Hong Kong. Your leadership will shape our success, foster strategic partnerships, and contribute to ShopBack’s vibrant culture.

Your Adventure Ahead
- Drive the overall growth, business strategy, business development with key stakeholders and business partners in Hong Kong.
- Full ownership of the sales, marketing and operations teams performance, execution and processes qualities to drive strong results.
- Accountable for the business's overall performance and P&L.
- Work closely with regional stakeholders and local heads of the online business to drive omnichannel growth
- Lead, empower, and mentor your team to bring about growth and development for a high performing unit
- Build and lead strategic plans and initiatives to ensure that ShopBack is well attuned to industry trends, opportunities, and competition landscape.
- Contribute to the overall success and culture of ShopBack.

Essentials to Succeed
- Solid experience in sales leadership, performance management, and exceeding team targets.
- Exceptional track record in online-to-offline sales; experience in the food/retail tech space is a plus.
- Proven direct experience in building, leading and inspiring lean and high-performing sales teams, with a fast-moving, continuous development mindset
- Have experience developing and executing creative, innovative integrated marketing campaigns that drive positive results in the local market.
- Outstanding networking skills and the ability to make partnerships happen, strong network of merchant partners in the food and retail space is highly valued.
- Ownership mindset, possess grit, tenacity, and hunger to win. A resilient problem solver who is not discouraged by failure.
- AI Competency: Demonstrated use of AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) to develop new or improve workflows, enhance productivity, and drive efficiency at scale.
